text: Then God said to me: "Jeremiah, even if Moses and Samuel stood here and made their case, I wouldn't feel a thing for this people. Get them out of here. Tell them to get lost!
" 'If you're assigned to die, go and die; if assigned to war, go and get killed; If assigned to starve, go starve; if assigned to exile, off to exile you go!'
"I've arranged for four kinds of punishment: death in battle, the corpses dropped off by killer dogs, the rest picked clean by vultures, the bones gnawed by hyenas.
They'll be a sight to see, a sight to shock the whole world—and all because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah and all he did in Jerusalem.
Who do you think will waste tears on you? Who will bother to take the time to ask, 'So, how are things going?'
"You turned your back and walked out. So I will grab you and hit you hard. I'm tired of letting you off the hook.
and let the winds scatter you like leaves. I made sure you'll lose everything, since nothing makes you change.
